eligibility.evidence: Abstract, Sec 1-3: new Moral Dilemma Dataset built from Reddit r/AITA posts (1,618 dilemmas) with crowd verdict distributions; ten LLMs scored on distributional alignment. No experimental manipulation, no cited cognitive paradigm or lab study (Sec 2.1-3.1). Borderline because it is a moral-judgment task with a human comparison.

A.title: The Pluralistic Moral Gap: Understanding Moral Judgment and Value Differences between Humans and Large Language Models
A.venue: Proceedings of the 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the ACL (EACL 2026), Long Papers

G.notes: Benchmark plus steering method on Reddit advice posts; human side is crowd_norms, not a cognitive experiment. A referee could argue moral judgment with human distributions qualifies; coded NO under the E2 provenance test (no paradigm cited). Sections 4.2-6 and appendices only skimmed by headings.
